item.longhaultracks.track_surveyor.tip1: Right-click a block: set route start, then end (a track block becomes a junction)
item.longhaultracks.track_surveyor.tip2: Right-click distant terrain or sky: pick a point far outside the loaded area
longhaultracks.map.hint: Long Haul Tracks: %s = route start, %s = route end at cursor
longhaultracks.gui.title: Track Surveyor
longhaultracks.gui.no_routes: No routes yet: set a start and an end.
longhaultracks.gui.junction: Joins existing track with a junction
longhaultracks.gui.help: Points: right-click blocks or far terrain with the surveyor, use [ and ] on Xaero's World Map, or /longtrack start|end|startxz|endxz. Floor block: decks, track beds, tunnel floors. Wall block: tunnel walls and ceilings (only built inside mountains) and pillars. Deposit pulls materials (also from shulker boxes) out of your inventory.
longhaultracks.msg.far_pick_none: No terrain found within %s blocks along that line.
longhaultracks.msg.too_long: Route would be about %s blocks; the limit is %s.
longhaultracks.msg.preview: Preview: confirm to survey, then supply materials
longhaultracks.msg.planned: Route planned: %s blocks (%s on bridges, %s in tunnels). Sneak-use the surveyor to review and confirm.
longhaultracks.msg.needs_more: The terrain needed more than counted: deposit the missing materials to continue
longhaultracks.msg.survey_done: Survey finished for your %s-block route: exact materials are listed in the planner.
longhaultracks.msg.complete_chat: Your %s-block line from %s to %s is built.
longhaultracks.msg.bad_block: %s cannot be used: pick a full, solid block without a block entity that does not fall.
